how.title: Your secrets stay yours
how.lead: SkySend encrypts everything in your browser before it leaves your device. The key travels in the link and never reaches the server. This page shows how.
how.flowKey: The key sits after the # in the link. Browsers never send that part, so the server only ever sees encrypted data.
how.demoText: Type something. It is encrypted right here with the same code SkySend uses for notes. Nothing is sent anywhere.
how.demoSample: The door code is 4711. See you at eight.
how.demoUnavailable: This browser does not allow Web Crypto on this page, so the demo cannot run. Open SkySend over HTTPS to try it.
how.step1Title: A key is made in your browser
how.step1Text: A random 256-bit secret is created on your device. Every key SkySend needs is derived from it.
how.step2Text: Files, file names and notes are encrypted before the first byte leaves your device.
how.step3Title: The key travels in the link
how.step3Text: The secret sits after the # in the link. Browsers never send that part to a server.
how.step4Title: Only the recipient can open it
how.step4Text: The recipient's browser decrypts the share. When the time or the limit runs out, it is deleted.
how.recordText: This is everything stored for a share. None of it can be turned back into your content.
how.featureExpiryText: Pick a lifetime and a download or view limit. When either runs out, the share is deleted.
how.featurePasswordText: Add a password as a second factor. It is stretched with Argon2id in the browser.
how.featureNotesText: Share text, Markdown, passwords, code and SSH keys as encrypted notes.
how.featureStreamText: Files are encrypted in 64 KB records as they stream to the server.
how.featurePrivacyText: SkySend has no user accounts and no tracking. Your upload history lives only in your browser.
how.featureOpenText: Anyone can read the code, check these claims and run their own instance.
how.specsText: For the curious. Standard, well-reviewed algorithms, all run by your browser.
how.specSecretValue: 256 bits from the browser's secure random generator
how.specKdfValue: HKDF-SHA256 with separate keys for content, metadata and auth
how.specAuthValue: HMAC-SHA256, proves the link without revealing it
how.specPasswordValue: Argon2id with 64 MiB of memory and 3 iterations
how.faq1Q: Can the people who run this server read my files?
how.faq1A: No. The server only ever receives encrypted data. The key is in the part of the link after the #, which browsers never send.
how.faq2Q: What if I lose the link?
how.faq2A: Then the share cannot be opened anymore. The key exists only in the link, so nobody can recover it, not even the operator.
how.faq3A: Someone who gets hold of the link still needs the password. Send it on a different channel than the link.
how.faq4A: When the time runs out or the download or view limit is reached, whichever comes first. You can also delete a share early under My Links.
how.ctaText: It takes a few seconds, and nobody but the recipient can read it.
